source_attribution: Todd, Robert E. and Alice S. Ren(2023), Gulf Stream mean and annual cycle from Spray underwater glider measurements. WHOI/Scripps Institution of Oceanography Instrument Development Group, doi:10.21238/S8TC9W. Underlying observations doi:10.21238/S8SPRAY2675 and10.21238/S8SPRAY0880. CC BY4.0.
source_kind: Published observation-based three-dimensional spatially mapped time mean and two-harmonic annual cycle, not raw independent casts, instantaneous velocities or model snapshots.
source_metadata_discrepancy: The mean ERDDAP metadata sets time_coverage_start and time_coverage_end to the same2015-07-16 timestamp, while its summary and primary product documentation describe2015-07-16 through2023-05-30. Preserve raw provider attributes and report documented fit period separately; do not treat the single mean coordinate as an observation date or silently repair provider metadata.
source_access_review: Primary Spray product page, mean metadata and annual-cycle access-form/DAS read2026-11-02. Annual DDS metadata retrieved confirms four-dimensional fields. No original paper figure pixels or digitization claimed.
regional_identity: NOAA independently documents Florida Current surveys across the Straits at27N. Restrict this Gulf Stream-system product to its Florida Straits section; no assignment to downstream current:gulf-stream, North Atlantic Current or family-level physical depth.
spatial_selection: Fixed source0.1degree grid at27N and longitudes80.1–79.1W, chosen as a Florida Straits corridor before velocity retrieval. Preserve all retained northward columns and section bounds. A maximum at an outermost column is axis-unresolved; do not broaden the window to force an interior peak.
horizontal_core_operator: Among columns with complete finite native10–200m northward support and at least one sample>0.05m/s, maximize positive signed trapezoidal integral over10–200m. First longitude in source order breaks ties. Equal integration support prevents a missing shallow bin from gaining an incomparable score. This is an OSW fitted-section axis proxy, not independently observed instantaneous axis tracking.
vertical_operator: First adjacent finite downward northward-component threshold crossing below a qualifying sampled0–200m core, using frozen connected-layer logic. Missing/dry levels or native domain end censor the crossing; do not jump disconnected deep flow or substitute seabed depth. Native10m shallowest level is not the surface.
relative_core_operator: Retain a separately typed first descending half-sampled-upper200m-core-component depth as a vertical decay descriptor. This is neither an absolute5/10/20cm/s contour nor a physical current bottom, full thickness or uncertainty bound.
temporal_selection: Time mean plus one unique provider annual-cycle phase labelled calendar day15 for each month. Preserve actual fitted phase timestamp and source index; years label first annual occurrence after fit-period start and are not independent observed dates. These are12 phase samples, not monthly averages or actual annual extrema.
support_interpretation: Retain provider mapping scales, downstream direction, observation/mission fit counts, max-gap and angular coverage at each selected profile. Mapping scales are Gaussian weights, not current widths; counts are not independent replicate numbers; source component standard errors are not propagated depth confidence intervals.
processing_policy: Sequential coordinate-first OPeNDAP subsets and tests on one idle cloud CPU. Before each case enforce100 fitted depth levels, at most20 section longitudes and cumulative100000 scalar budget including selected fit-support values. Retain decoded profiles and source metadata; no full-source/wire-byte hash claim. No local tests or ocean-field processing.
